notes.title: Experience Agence with the Devs - Interactive Ontario Steam Sale 2022
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Agence will be participating in this year's Ontario Steam Sale from September 7th - 14th where you can re-experience the magic if you haven’t already for 83% off!


In 2020, Transitional Forms released its first project, called Agence, as an industry-first experimental dynamic film co-produced with the National Film Board, and with funding support from the Canada Media Fund and Ontario Creates. Agence had its world premiere at the 77th Venice International Film Festival (2020), accessible worldwide in seven languages, and was also featured at the BFI London Film Festival and IDFA Doc Lab.
